svg.title: Weekly commits to each protocol main repository
svg.desc: Small multiples, one panel per repository, shared scale. MCP 1991 commits; x402 1033 commits; MPP 1007 commits; KYA-OS 324 commits; UCP 319 commits; A2A 238 commits; L402 215 commits; ACP 100 commits; Web Bot Auth 93 commits; ANS 74 commits; AP2 20 commits; x401 14 commits; cheqd 8 commits; PAP 3 commits; TAP 1 commits
svg.text: Weekly commits to each protocol's main repository
Last 52 weeks to mid-Oct 2026. Same scale in every panel (0 to 160), sorted by total commits.
A flat line on the baseline means no recent development. Repositories created during the year start part-way along.
